title: 3572. Maximize Y‑Sum by Picking a Triplet of Distinct X‑Values

examples.explanation: Choose i = 0 (x[i] = 1, y[i] = 5), j = 1 (x[j] = 2, y[j] = 3), k = 3 (x[k] = 3, y[k] = 6). All three values chosen from x are distinct. 5 + 3 + 6 = 14 is the maximum we can obtain. Hence, the output is 14.
There are only two distinct values in x. Hence, the output is -1.
